prompt_policies.canonical_control_is: the baseline_route reference row: same weights, same canonical prompt, so it is not re-run as a policy

sft_target.label: direct supervised fine-tuning (frozen cell E)
sft_target.objective: teacher-forced CE descent on target+retain pairs
sft_target.note: the existing seed-17 edited cell checkpoint is reused after hash validation and re-scored by this runner

cf_relabel.label: counterfactual supervised relabeling
cf_relabel.objective: teacher-forced CE descent toward the counterfactual label
cf_relabel.note: for a transformation target the counterfactual label IS the requested coarser label, so CF and direct SFT coincide by construction; recorded as an alias, never as independent evidence

gd_distribution.label: GD distribution matching toward the coarser label
gd_distribution.objective: KL(one-hot(target) || normalized full-sequence candidate scores) + retain descent
gd_distribution.note: full-sequence label scores, batched; the refusal variant's first-token matching cannot express a bin transformation because '15 years' and the 15-19 bin share a first token

ga_retain_descent.label: gradient ascent on the source + retain descent
ga_retain_descent.objective: ascent on the source association, descent on retain+target
ga_retain_descent.note: rv.train_ga as corrected in RV: ascent on the forget side only, so retention is genuinely trained

npo.label: Negative Preference Optimization vs the pre-edit reference
npo.objective: -log sigmoid(beta * (loss_theta - loss_ref)) on the source association + 0.1 * retain/target descent
npo.note: beta frozen at the RV3 value; reference = pre-edit route

kl_anchored_edit.label: KL-anchored editing (descent + anchor)
kl_anchored_edit.objective: CE descent on target+retain + beta_kl * KL(pi_theta || pi_ref) on retain prompts
kl_anchored_edit.note: the transformation reading of 'KL-anchored editing': the anchor bounds drift while the descent installs the label

kl_ascent_anchor.label: rv.train_kl as shipped for deletion (ascent + anchor)
kl_ascent_anchor.objective: ascent on the source association + beta_kl * KL(pi_theta || pi_ref) on the retain set, and no CE descent anywhere
kl_ascent_anchor.note: kept as its own row: it has NO descent term, so it cannot install a coarser label -- measured, not asserted

prompt_only.label: prompting-only policy (no weight change)
prompt_only.objective: none: frozen baseline route under instruction policies
prompt_only.note: retention and sibling numbers are 1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION (weights untouched) and are never presented as a method advantage

matched_retrain.label: fresh matched retraining (oracle)
matched_retrain.objective: fresh-LoRA supervised training on target+retain with the original route protocol
matched_retrain.note: the existing matched_retrain oracle checkpoint is reused; 3000/200/2e-5 is NOT the edit budget and is flagged.  This is the WEIGHTED matched reference (target x5) every existing Delta_retrain number was measured against; whether the reading survives WITHOUT the boost is GX2B's question and is not re-litigated here

baseline_route.label: pre-edit baseline route h (floor)
baseline_route.note: the association route before any edit; no target installed

loo_retrain.label: fresh leave-one-out retraining (deletion reference)
loo_retrain.note: the reference Delta_retrain is measured against

identical_across_trainable_methods: initialization (the frozen baseline route h, loaded fail-closed before every method)
may_differ: the objective and which pair set feeds which side of it

sanctioned_exception.reason: fresh-retrain oracles keep their own frozen protocol (3000/200/2e-5, target x5, retain x50, fresh LoRA init, seed 17); they are references for the distance metric, not budget-matched competitors, and every row records its own recipe so the difference is never implicit

scoring_limitation.candidate_mass_is: sum of normalized full-sequence label scores WITHOUT a termination event; overlapping candidate strings can sum above 1
scoring_limitation.consequence: normalized candidate-score comparisons and gated distances remain comparable across methods and to every existing artifact, but min_candidate_mass>=0.99 is a threshold on a SCORE SUM, not on a probability
scoring_limitation.same_scorer_as: scripts/e2c_v3_research_validity.py full_sequence_label_probs + build_candidate_summary, the frozen scorer every other artifact uses

pass_criteria_reference.e2e_policy: unconditional E2E is NOT a pass requirement where the frozen route failed its held-out gate; association and routing conclusions are gated separately
